rules.title: San Diego ban on providing algorithmic devices to landlords
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. Subsection (b) is also an unlawful act but is cut off in the available text.
rules.quoted_span: (a) It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord.
rules.coverage_text: The available text does not state which landlords or properties are covered; it refers generally to landlords.
